title: Re-register Hostinger Tenant Canary workflow under a canonical Actions path

phases.objective: Keep one canonical Tenant Canary workflow identity while preserving its runner, evidence contract, routing, and binding to the current generic CI Evidence PR Publisher.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and trusted CI evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The canonical Tenant Canary workflow file, bootstrap test, routing registry, and generic CI evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow remains present at one canonical path, keeps the exact trusted name and read-only authority boundary, and publishes through the current generic publisher.
steps: Require one canonical workflow path and remove obsolete workflow identities.
Verify exact-head checkout, artifact identity, routing, bootstrap regression, and generic publisher binding.
assertions: The generic publisher consumes the same workflow name and artifact contract.

phases.objective: Observe the first qualifying exact-head Tenant Canary run and trusted publication through the canonical generic publisher.
Reject stale heads, unavailable contexts, missing artifacts, malformed reports, and publisher-route drift while remaining fail closed.
Record exact-head canonical Tenant Canary evidence through the trusted publisher.
